items.title: Access Ready Inc Joins the World Institute on Disability in a Call to Action
items.description:
Join the global call to action for disability rights in 2025. Support policies aligned with the ADA, CRPD, and international frameworks to ensure accessibility, inclusion, and dignity for 1.3 billion people with disabilities worldwide. Sign the letter today!

items.title: Access Ready, Inc. Supports the American Council of the Blind (ACB) 2025 Legislative Imperatives
items.description:
Discover how the 2025 legislative imperatives, including the Communications, Video, and Technology Accessibility Act (CVTA), the Medical Device Nonvisual Accessibility Act, and the Websites and Software Applications Accessibility Act, are shaping a more inclusive future for blind, low vision, and DeafBlind individuals. Stay informed and support digital accessibility today!

items.title: Vermonters With Hearing And Vision Loss Fear End Of A Pilot Program
items.description:
The program helps Vermonters with hearing and vision loss run errands, attend events and socialize. But grant funding is slated to expire this fall, and clients and advocates fear the program will cease without it. Read More

items.title: NH Advocates Push To End Use Of ‘Special’ When Talking About Disability
items.description:
Disability rights groups in New Hampshire are pushing to end use of the word “special” when talking about people with disabilities. They say the term is demeaning, casts people with disabilities as “others” and suggests they don’t belong in the same spaces as everyone else. “When we say that people with disabilities are ‘special,’ we’re...

items.description:

This device combines versatile applications, seamless multi-device connections, and ergonomic design to redefine accessibility for the visually impaired. Read More
